pr_title: Add support for SpinnerFrequencyModulate skin config option
pr_body:
Closes #9738.
VSCode helpfully tried to turn it back into tabs when I tried to put spaces instead so that's the reason for the double commit, squash if you wish.
pr_comments: Sorry for all the hassle, haven't touched a project with such high standards in a while.
Source looks saner now but not sure how to test. Either a link to a skin that has this off or a test scene would do I suppose. As a last resort I guess I could manufacture a barebones skin myself.

I can do the proper test skin if you want but if you want me to do the test scene then please do elaborate (in-game? headless? how to automate?)

P.S: So far I've just rigged up two versions of my favorite skin

Well, I presume you tested this change in some capacity?

As the thing being tested is auditory it shouldn't be headless. I suppose a barebones scene with a skin that has it on and another one that has it off so that there is an audible change would be enough, but again, I don't really insist on it as long as there is *some* way to check that this is working provided as part of this PR.

> P.S: So far I've just rigged up two versions of my favorite skin

(and it works)
alright, got it [uploaded](https://i.ronthecookie.me/pull9869.zip). (was too big for github)

issue_context.title: SpinnerFrequencyModulate skin setting is not implemented
issue_context.body:
**Describe the new feature:** 
Implement the SpinnerFrequencyModulate skin setting

**Proposal designs of the feature:** 
Turn off SpinnerFrequencyModulate in the skin for the spinner sound to not pitch up.

**osu!lazer version:** 
2020.801.0
**Logs:**
[performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5008454/performance.log)
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5008455/runtime.log)
[updater.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5008456/updater.log)
[database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5008457/database.log)
[network.txt](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5008471/network.txt)
comments:
1. `SpinnerFrequencyModulate` is not yet implemented. 
2. osu!lazer now has a setting to always play combo break on first time, you can disable that if you don't want it to.

This issue can be renamed to track implementing `SpinnerFrequencyModulate`.
The setting seems to be removed from the ui in [`956980e` (#8802)](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/8802/commits/956980ee9055738a73dd9791ca52ff1a3de2ab18), and can only change it in `game.ini`.

We have intentionally made the first combo break play a sound, as it is the most-common use case. Probably not going to change for now unless a large sample of users can make a strong argument against it.

I'm re-purposing this issue to cover the `SpinnerFrequencyModulate` issue.

review_comments: This can't be done on `load()` as it'll break if you change between skins that have different values of this configuration lookup. See ~~`SkinReloadableDrawable.SkinChanged()`~~ `ApplySkin()` as mentioned below for how to do this properly.
This should be done inside `ApplySkin` instead. The way you're doing it won't work correctly when the skin is changed.
I believe this shouldn't reside in the main `DrawableSpinner`, but in the legacy spinner implementations.
not sure about this one. also though so but would likely involve moving the sample playback completely. maybe something which can be done at a later point.
